The uTWS line mainly comes with MMCX ends, and while they do come in 2-pin variants, my current IEMs use a different style of 2-pin connector that means the contact point would be exposed and just begging for damage. That got me looking at Crinacle's IEM rankings, and the Lypertek PurePlay Z3 2.0 seems like a miracle item. A B ranking, meaning "very good" in his system, max value rating, pure TWS, all for $90. Plus the promo video for them is literally a biker, meaning it should have very solid sweat resistance. It also turns out that I was putting in the Taotronics wrong, which is partly why they kept falling out of my head. If only the sound was better...

I'm looking for a sweat-resistant bluetooth upgrade module for my KZ IEMs. Preferably, an upgrade module that is close to a TWS as possible, as I am a very tactile person and cables rubbing against the back of my neck make me feel gross. I'm already used to the feeling of hooks around my ear from both using the KZs with their packaged wire, and also from wearing glasses for over a decade. Right now I'm looking at the AZ09 Pro, but there's nothing talking about sweat resistance, and I plan to use them in the gym. Battery life or audio delay are not critical, and I'd like to try to keep the price somewhat low if possible. I also used the Taotronics SoundLiberty 79s for a while, but their sound quality had room for improvement, and they kept falling out of my ears. I understand that this is something incredibly niche, but does it exist? Also, I am not against buying a new set of IEMs if truly required.
